## Load Required Libraries
```{r}
library(diagram)
library(HDInterval)
library(lubridate)
library(seraphim)
library(treeio)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)
library(sf)
```

## 1. Preparing the Input Files
```{r}
setwd("~/Documents/backup11:08:2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetB/NewDataAnalysis/phylogeography/timetree/discreteTrait/analysisWithR/")

analysis <- "GambaGlobalDatasetB.pass.alignedDiscretSupsamples"
removeSuspiciousHomoplasies <- FALSE
writingFiles <- TRUE
showingPlots <- TRUE

tree <- read.nexus(paste0(analysis, ".tree"))

if (grepl("GambaGlobalDatasetB.pass.alignedDiscretSupsamples", analysis)) {
  seqIDs <- tree$tip.label
  countries <- rep(NA, length(seqIDs))
  collectionDates <- rep(NA, length(seqIDs))
  
  for (i in 1:length(seqIDs)) {
    if (grepl("hCoV-19", seqIDs[i])) {
      countries[i] <- unlist(strsplit(seqIDs[i],"\\/"))[2]
    } else {
      countries[i] <- unlist(strsplit(seqIDs[i],"\\/"))[1]
    }
    
    split_seq <- unlist(strsplit(seqIDs[i], "\\|"))
    
    if (length(split_seq) == 3) {
      collectionDates[i] <- split_seq[length(split_seq)]
    } else if (length(split_seq) == 4) {
      collectionDates[i] <- split_seq[length(split_seq) - 1]
    }
  }
  
  tab <- data.frame(Strain = seqIDs, Country = countries, CollectionData = collectionDates)
  write.csv(tab, paste0(analysis, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  data <- read.csv(paste0(analysis, ".csv"))
}
```

## 2. Import DatasetB Annotation File
```{r}
gambiaData <- read.csv("~/Documents/backup11_08_2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetB/NewDataAnalysis/datasetBdates.txt", sep = "\t")

gambiaData <- gambiaData %>%
  mutate(country = "Gambia") %>%
  rename(Strain = Name) %>%
  select(Strain, country, date) %>%
  rename(Collection.data = date)

joinData <- left_join(data, gambiaData, by = "Strain")
joinData$Country <- ifelse(joinData$Strain == joinData$Country, "Gambia", joinData$Country)
joinData <- joinData %>% select(Strain, Country, Collection.data)
joinData$Collection.data <- as.Date(as.character(joinData$Collection.data), format = "%Y-%m-%d")
joinData$Country[1119] <- "Wuhan"

write.csv(joinData, paste0(analysis, ".csv"))
```

## 3. Visualizing the Phylogenetic Tree
```{r}
if (showingPlots) {
  plot(tree, type="fan", show.tip.label=FALSE, edge.width=0.5, cex=0.6, col="gray30")
  add.scale.bar(lwd=0.5, lcol="gray30", cex=0.7)
}
```

## 4. Analysis of Discrete Phylogeographic Results
```{r}
burnIn <- 501
computingHPDInterval <- FALSE

if (computingHPDInterval) {
  trees <- scan(paste0(analysis, ".trees"), what = "", sep = "\n", quiet = TRUE)
  indices2 <- which(grepl("tree STATE_", trees))
  gambianIntroductions_list <- rep(NA, length(trees))
  
  for (i in (burnIn + 1):length(indices2)) {
    tree1 <- trees[c(indices2[i])]
    tree2 <- readAnnotatedNexus(textConnection(tree1))
    
    gambianIntroductions <- sum(sapply(tree2$annotations, function(x) x$states == "Gambia"))
    gambianIntroductions_list[i] <- gambianIntroductions
  }
  
  HPD <- HDInterval::hdi(gambianIntroductions_list[!is.na(gambianIntroductions_list)])
  cat("Estimated lineage introductions: ", median(gambianIntroductions_list, na.rm=TRUE), " (95% HPD = [", HPD[1], "-", HPD[2], "])\n")
}
```

## 5. Save Processed Data
```{r}
write.table(joinData, paste0(analysis, "_processed.txt"), row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```

## Summary
This script processes phylogenetic data, visualizes it, and analyzes lineage dispersal patterns in Gambia. The results help understand the introduction and spread of viral lineages.
